'''Jenare Balmaen''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jenare Balmaen}}

== Appearance ==
She is pale and sturdy. She has a pale, square face.{{ref/book|11|27}}

== Strength and Abilities ==
Jenare is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|31}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

== Activities ==
She was a part of the group of fifty-one sisters, led by [[Toveine Gazal]], sent by [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]] to take out the [[Black Tower]].{{ref/book|7|p}} Jenare was part of the group of ten sisters led by Toviene herself when they were both shielded and captured and bonded by the [[Asha'man]].{{ref/book|8|26}} Jenare was bonded by [[Welyn Kajima]], a fact for which she blamed Toveine.

Elaida abandons the Aes Sedai sent to capture the Black Tower, including Jenare, at [[Alviarin]]'s suggestion.{{ref/book|7|32}}

Jenare, along with several of the other captured Aes Sedai, blames Toveine Gazal for her capture.{{ref/book|9|p}}

Lemai and [[Desandre]] initiate orders that all captive sisters must achieve cordial status in the relationships with their captors in a ploy to lull the men into becoming amenable to them.{{ref/book|10|p}}

She [[Traveling|Traveled]] to [[Tear]] with Kajima to join up with Rand. Her relationship with Kajima seems a good one, at least on the surface, as [[Rand al'Thor]] observes the two of them laughing and joking together.{{ref/book|11|27}}

She watches from a distance Rand's meeting with the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] and Travels in as backup when it is revealed that the Daughter of the Nine Moons is actually [[Semirhage]].{{ref/book|11|27}}

When Kajima and Jenare return to Black Tower, it is suspected that she, along with Kajima, was [[Turned]] to the Shadow.{{ref/book|14|3}} This is later confirmed by "The Wheel of Time Companion". She is with Welyn when he tells the last of Logain's followers that Logain and Taim have patched their differences and now want a unified Tower for [[Tarmon Gai'don]]. Her final fate is unknown.
